title: Preservation of fan-in at most two
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n+m$ inputs and let $y$ assign Boolean values to the last $m$ inputs. If every gate of $C$ has distinct input vertices, every NOT gate has exactly one input, and every gate has at most two inputs, then the circuit obtained by hardwiring $y$ has these same properties.
